caption:
A good breakfast to fuel up my day😍😍
.
.
Started of with a plate of Cup Idli, Vade Sambar dip and trust the sambar was sweet, flavourful and was perfect as and when it was absorbed by Idli & Vade.
Finally we ended our breakfast with a plate of vegetable dose, healthy yet tasty🤩🤩
Do give it a try and let me know your feedback in the comment box😉😉
.
.
Location : Vishwapriya Tindi Kendra, Shop No. 7, 7th Block, Jayanagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560070
Price : ₹ 150 approx for 2 persons
Ratings : 4.5/5
.
.
Do Follow @foodie_brahamana for more such amazing and droll worthy content😃😋🤤
.
.
